Securing future employment can be intimidating — but taking a few practical steps can bring a feeling of control. Get job-ready Thinking about VET? VET is Vocational Education and Training that gets you job-ready and builds skills to support your career. What is VET? Thinking about a traineeship or apprenticeship Students can start working on an apprenticeship or traineeship from Year 10. You will earn a wage, train with an employer, and work towards an accredited qualification while undertaking your South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE).
